notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Ridgescale Tusker.
description:
Activate Ridgescale Tusker by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Ridgescale Tusker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ridgescale Tusker.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
